description_en: You can invoke ListIntervalInstanceReport to obtain the segment statistical report for a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListIntervalInstanceReport获取指定实例的分段统计报表
name: ListIntervalInstanceReport

parameters.help_en: Start Time, in UNIX timestamp format with millisecond precision. This parameter is optional. The default value is 00:00 of the current day. The time granularity for statistics is hourly, rounded down to the nearest hour, and uses a closed interval
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认为当天的0时，统计的时间精度为小时，向前取整，闭区间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End Time, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. This parameter is optional. The default value is the current time. If Interval is Daily, the maximum interval between StartTime and EndTime is 180 days. If Interval is Hourly, the maximum interval is 10 days. The time precision for statistics is hourly, snapped backward to the start of the hour, using an open interval. For example, if the original Start Time is 11:12:20 and End Time is 11:45:50, the aligned time range becomes [11:00:00, 12:00:00), meaning greater than or equal to 11:00:00 and less than 12:00:00
parameters.help_zh: 截止时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒，非必填，默认是当前时间，如果Interval为Daily，StartTime和EndTime最大间隔是180天。如果Interval为Hourly，最大间隔时间为10天。统计的时间精度为小时，向后取整，开区间。例如：开始时间为11:12:20，结束时间为11:45:50，则对齐后的入参时间范围为[11:00:00,12:00:00) ，即大于等于11点，小于12点
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Segment statistics type. This parameter is optional. The default value is Daily (daily aggregation)
parameters.help_zh: 分段统计类型，非必填，默认为Daily（按天汇总）
parameters.name: interval

Data.description_en: List of instance segment statistics data
Data.description_zh: 实例分段统计数据列表

AbandonRate.description_en: Abandon rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandoned / CallsOffered (because management events related to abandonment and assignment may fall into different Time Ranges, the Result may exceed 100% in certain cases)
AbandonRate.description_zh: 放弃率。计算公式为：CallsAbandoned/CallsOffered（由于放弃事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AbandonedRate.description_en: Deprecated. Refer to the AbandonRate field instead
AbandonedRate.description_zh: 已废弃，该字段可以参考AbandonRate

AverageAbandonTime.description_en: The average abandon time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonTime / CallsAbandoned
AverageAbandonTime.description_zh: 平均放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonTime/CallsAbandoned

AverageAbandonedInIVRTime.description_en: Average IVR abandonment time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonedInIVRTime / CallsAbandonedInIVR
AverageAbandonedInIVRTime.description_zh: 平均IVR放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonedInIVRTime/CallsAbandonedInIVR

AverageAbandonedInQueueTime.description_en: Average queue abandonment duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonedInQueueTime / CallsAbandonedInQueue
AverageAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 平均排队放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonedInQueueTime/CallsAbandonedInQueue

AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description_en: Average abandoned-in-ring time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalAbandonedInRingTime / CallsAbandonedInRing
AverageAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃放弃时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalAbandonedInRingTime/CallsAbandonedInRing

AverageFirstResponseTime.description_en: Average first response time for chat sessions, in seconds
AverageFirstResponseTime.description_zh: Chat会话平均首次响应时长，单位为秒

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average call hold duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/CallsHold

AverageResponseTime.description_en: Average response time (RT) of chat sessions

AverageRingTime.description_en: Average ring time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalRingTime / CallsRinged
AverageRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalRingTime/CallsRinged

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsHandled
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalTalkTime/CallsHandled

AverageWaitTime.description_en: Average wait time, which is the average duration callers wait before an agent answers a call. Calculation Formula: TotalWaitTime / CallsHandled
AverageWaitTime.description_zh: 平均等待时长，平均每通电话的坐席接起前等待时长。计算公式为： TotalWaitTime/CallsHandled

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsHandled
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalWorkTime/CallsHandled

CallsAbandoned.description_en: Total abandoned calls. Calculation Formula: CallsAbandonedInIVR + CallsAbandonedInQueue + CallsAbandonedInRing

CallsAbandonedInIVR.description_en: Number of calls abandoned in IVR, which refers to the count of calls where the Customer hung up during the IVR flow after entering the IVR process
CallsAbandonedInIVR.description_zh: IVR放弃量，即电话进入IVR流程之后在IVR环节客户挂机的数量

CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_en: The number of calls abandoned in the queue, which refers to calls where the customer hung up while waiting in the queue after entering it
CallsAbandonedInQueue.description_zh: 队列放弃量，即电话进入队列之后在排队环节客户挂机的数量

CallsAbandonedInRing.description_en: Number of calls abandoned during ringing, which refers to the Quantity of calls where the Customer hung up while the agent's phone was ringing
CallsAbandonedInRing.description_zh: 振铃放弃量，即坐席振铃中客户挂机的数量

CallsAbandonedInVoiceNavigator.description_en: The number of calls abandoned in the Intelligent Navigation module
CallsAbandonedInVoiceNavigator.description_zh: 通话在智能导航模块放弃的数量

CallsAttendedTransferred.description_en: Number of consult transfers, which refers to the Count of calls that involved a consult transfer. If a single call initiated multiple transfers, it is counted as one
CallsAttendedTransferred.description_zh: 咨询转接量，即发生咨询转接的电话数量。若一通电话发起多次转接，算一次

CallsBlindTransferred.description_en: Quantity of blind transfers, which is the number of calls that were directly transferred. If a single call was transferred multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsBlindTransferred.description_zh: 直接转接量，即发生直接转接的电话数量。若一通电话发起多次转接，算一次

CallsCausedIVRException.description_en: Number of calls that caused IVR exceptions

CallsForwardToOutsideNumber.description_en: The number of calls forwarded to an external number
CallsForwardToOutsideNumber.description_zh: 发生转外线的通话数量

CallsHandled.description_en: The acknowledgement count, which refers to the number of calls answered by agents. If a single call is answered by multiple agents, it is counted as one
CallsHandled.description_zh: 应答量，即坐席应答的电话数量。若一通电话被多个坐席应答，算一次

CallsHold.description_en: Number of calls placed on hold. If a single call is placed on hold multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsHold.description_zh: 保持量，即发生通话保持的电话数量。若一通电话保持多次，算一次

CallsIVRException.description_en: The number of calls with IVR exceptions. A call is counted when the IVR enters a hang-up reason node and the hang-up reason configured for that node is "failed transfer to agent." In this case, the count increases by 1
CallsIVRException.description_zh: 发生IVR异常的通话数量，判定条件是IVR进入了挂机原因节点且挂机原因节点设置的挂机原因为转人工失败，此时计数加1

CallsOffered.description_en: Number of calls offered to Cloud Contact Center
CallsOffered.description_zh: 呼入到云联络中心的电话数量

CallsQueued.description_en: Number of calls that entered the queue. If a single call entered the queue multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsQueued.description_zh: 进入队列的电话数量，若一通电话多次进入队列，算一次

CallsQueuingFailed.description_en: Queue Failure quantity, which refers to the number of calls where the customer hung up during queuing after the call entered the queue
CallsQueuingFailed.description_zh: 队列失败量，即电话进入队列之后在排队环节客户挂机的数量

CallsQueuingOverflow.description_en: Quantity of calls that overflowed from the queue, meaning calls that encountered queue overflow while waiting in the IVR queue
CallsQueuingOverflow.description_zh: 队列溢出的通话数量，即通话在IVR排队时队列溢出

CallsQueuingTimeout.description_en: Number of calls that timed out during the queuing phase
CallsQueuingTimeout.description_zh: 在排队阶段超时的通话数量

CallsRinged.description_en: Number of calls that rang to agents. If a single call was assigned to multiple agents and rang for each, it is counted as one
CallsRinged.description_zh: 座席振铃的电话数量，若一通电话分配给多个座席并产生了振铃，算一次

CallsToVoicemail.description_en: Quantity of calls transferred to voicemail
CallsToVoicemail.description_zh: 转入语音信箱的电话数量

CallsVoicemail.description_en: The number of calls directed to voicemail
CallsVoicemail.description_zh: 通话进入语音留言信箱的数量

HandleRate.description_en: Acknowledgement rate. Calculation Formula: CallsHandled / CallsOffered (because acknowledgement events and assign events may fall into different time ranges, the result may exceed 100% in certain cases)
HandleRate.description_zh: 应答率。计算公式为：CallsHandled/CallsOffered（由于应答事件与分配事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

MaxAbandonTime.description_en: The maximum abandon time, in seconds

MaxAbandonedInIVRTime.description_en: Maximum IVR abandonment duration, in seconds

MaxAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 最大排队放弃时长，单位秒

MaxAbandonedInRingTime.description_en: Maximum ring abandonment duration, in seconds
MaxAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 最大振铃放弃时长，单位秒

MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxWaitTime.description_en: The maximum wait time, in seconds

MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

SatisfactionIndex.description_en: Satisfaction index, which is the average value of the satisfaction keypress digits (single-digit numbers)
SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Number of evaluations marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

SatisfactionSurveysResponded.description_en: The count of satisfaction survey responses

ServiceLevel20.description_en: Service level within 20 seconds, calculated as the number of calls with wait time less than or equal to 20 seconds divided by CallsQueued
ServiceLevel20.description_zh: 20秒服务水平，等待时长小于等于20秒的电话数量/CallsQueued

TotalAbandonedInIVRTime.description_en: Total IVR abandonment duration, in seconds

TotalAbandonedInQueueTime.description_zh: 总排队放弃时长，单位秒

TotalAbandonedInRingTime.description_zh: 总振铃放弃时长，单位秒

TotalHoldTime.description_en: Total hold time during calls, in seconds
TotalHoldTime.description_zh: 总通话保持时长，单位秒

TotalMessagesSent.description_en: Total number of messages sent in chat sessions

TotalMessagesSentByAgent.description_en: Total number of messages sent by agents in chat sessions
TotalMessagesSentByAgent.description_zh: Chat会话中坐席发送的总消息量

TotalMessagesSentByCustomer.description_en: Total number of messages sent by the Customer in chat sessions
TotalMessagesSentByCustomer.description_zh: Chat会话中客户发送的总消息量

TotalWaitTime.description_en: The total wait time, in seconds

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒

AnswerRate.description_en: Answer rate. Calculation Formula: CallsAnswered / CallsDialed (because management events for answering and acknowledgement may fall into different Time Ranges, the Result may exceed 100% in certain cases)
AnswerRate.description_zh: 接通率，计算公式为：CallsAnswered/CallsDialed（由于接听事件与应答事件可能落在不同的时间范围内，所以某些情况下结果可能大于100%）

AverageDialingTime.description_en: Average dial-up duration, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalDialingTime / CallsDialed
AverageDialingTime.description_zh: 平均拨号时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalDialingTime/CallsDialed

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average hold duration, in seconds. Calculation formula: TotalHoldTime / CallsHold
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/CallsHold

AverageRingTime.description_en: Average ring time in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalRingTime / CallsRinged
AverageRingTime.description_zh: 平均振铃时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalRingTime/CallsRinged

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / CallsAnswered
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalTalkTime/CallsAnswered

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing time in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / CallsDialed
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalWorkTime/CallsDialed

CallsAttendedTransferred.description_en: The number of calls transferred via consultation, which refers to the quantity of calls that underwent consultation-based transfer. If a single call was transferred multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsAttendedTransferred.description_zh: 咨询转接量，即发生咨询转接的电话数量。若一通电话发起多次转接，算一次

CallsBlindTransferred.description_en: Quantity of blind transfers, which refers to the number of calls that were directly transferred. If a single call is transferred multiple times, it counts as one
CallsBlindTransferred.description_zh: 直接转接量，即发生直接转接的电话数量。若一通电话发起多次转接，算一次

CallsHold.description_en: Number of calls placed on hold. If a single call is placed on hold multiple times, it is counted as one
CallsHold.description_zh: 保持量，即发生通话保持的电话数量。若一通电话保持多次，算一次

CallsRinged.description_en: Number of calls that rang for agents. If a single call is assigned to multiple agents and rings for each, it is counted as one
CallsRinged.description_zh: 坐席振铃的电话数量，若一通电话分配给多个座席并产生了振铃，算一次

MaxHoldTime.description_en: Maximum hold time during calls, in seconds
MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

SatisfactionIndex.description_en: Satisfaction index, which is the average value of the single-digit satisfaction key presses
SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Quantity of evaluations marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

TotalHoldTime.description_zh: 总通话保持时长，单位秒

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒

AverageBreakTime.description_en: Average break time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalBreakTime / Break Count. Break Count is not an API statistics field
AverageBreakTime.description_zh: 平均小休时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalBreakTime/小休次数。小休次数为非接口统计字段

AverageHoldTime.description_en: Average call hold time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalHoldTime / (Inbound Calls on Hold + Outbound Calls on Hold)
AverageHoldTime.description_zh: 平均通话保持时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalHoldTime/(呼入CallsHold+呼出CallsHold)

AverageReadyTime.description_en: Average ready time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalReadyTime / Ready Count. Ready Count is not an API statistics field
AverageReadyTime.description_zh: 平均就绪时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalReadyTime/就绪次数。就绪次数为非接口统计字段

AverageTalkTime.description_en: Average talk time, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalTalkTime / (CallsAnswered + CallsHandled)
AverageTalkTime.description_zh: 平均通话时长，单位秒。计算公式为： TotalTalkTime/(CallsAnswered+CallsHandled)

AverageWorkTime.description_en: Average post-processing time per call, in seconds. Calculation Formula: TotalWorkTime / TotalCalls
AverageWorkTime.description_zh: 平均话后处理时长，单位秒。计算公式为：TotalWorkTime/TotalCalls

MaxHoldTime.description_en: Maximum call hold time, in seconds
MaxHoldTime.description_zh: 最大通话保持时长，单位秒

MaxWorkTime.description_zh: 最大话后处理时长，单位秒

OccupancyRate.description_en: Agent occupancy rate. Calculation Formula: (TotalWorkTime + TotalTalkTime) / TotalLoggedInTime
OccupancyRate.description_zh: 座席利用率，计算公式为： (TotalworkTime + TotalTalkTime ) / TotalLoggedInTime

SatisfactionIndex.description_en: Satisfaction index, which is the average value of the satisfaction keypress digits (single-digit numbers)
SatisfactionIndex.description_zh: 满意度指数，即满意度按键数字（1位数字）的平均值

SatisfactionRate.description_en: Satisfaction rate. Calculation Formula: Count of evaluations marked as satisfied / Count of satisfaction survey responses
SatisfactionRate.description_zh: 满意率，计算公式为：标记为满意的评价数/满意度调查响应次数

TotalCalls.description_en: Total call volume. Calculation Formula: CallsOffered + CallsDialed
TotalCalls.description_zh: 总电话量。计算公式为：CallsOffered + CallsDialed

TotalLoggedInTime.description_en: Total logon duration, in seconds. Exclude break time
TotalLoggedInTime.description_zh: 总登录时长，单位秒。不包含小休时长

TotalWorkTime.description_zh: 总话后处理时长，单位秒

StatsTime.description_en: Start Time, formatted as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
StatsTime.description_zh: 开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位毫秒
